gloss: as one wishes; as expected; the way one wants

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; as one expects; the way one intended or hoped
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation or outcome that matches what someone wanted, planned, or envisioned. Can be used both when things go well and when lamenting that things did not go as hoped.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{通|どお}りにいかないこともある。
examples.english: Sometimes things don't go as planned.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}が{思|おも}い{通|どお}りに{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: The plan is progressing just as expected.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{思|おも}い{通|どお}りにならないと{泣|な}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: The child starts crying when things don't go their way.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}り、{思|おも}い{通|どお}りの{結果|けっか}を{得|え}ることができた。
examples.english: Years of effort bore fruit, and I was able to get the results I had hoped for.

notes:
Composed of {思|おも}い (thought, wish) + {通|どお}り (in accordance with). Almost always used with the particle に to form the adverbial phrase {思|おも}い{通|どお}りに. Very common in everyday Japanese. The negative pattern {思|おも}い{通|どお}りにいかない (things don't go as planned) is especially frequent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}りになる: to go as one wants
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}りにならない: to not go as one wants
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}りにいく: to go as planned
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}りにいかない: to not go as planned
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}りの{結果|けっか}: the result one hoped for

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予想|よそう}{通|どお}り: as expected — based on prediction rather than desire
- {期待|きたい}{通|どお}り: as hoped — close synonym, emphasizes expectation
- {思|おも}うがまま: as one pleases — more literary; emphasizes freedom of action rather than outcomes matching wishes
- {計画|けいかく}{通|どお}り: according to plan — focuses on following a specific plan
